key.name: toggle-position
key.description: below-wifi, after-wifi, start, end or custom

key.name: tile-layout
key.summary: Real Quick Settings tile order (written by the extension)
key.description: JSON list of visible one-column tiles; q=1 marks the Qurp tile. Used by the preferences window.

key.name: toggle-slot
key.description: Zero-based index among the visible Quick Settings tiles. Used when toggle-position is custom.

key.name: ping-mode
key.description: real (through the proxy core) or tcp (plain TCP connect)

key.name: sub-update-hours
key.summary: Subscription auto-update interval in hours (0 = off)

key.name: tls-skip-verify
key.summary: Skip TLS certificate verification for every server

key.name: routing-direct-domains
key.summary: Domains that bypass the proxy (comma separated suffixes)

key.name: routing-direct-ips
key.summary: IPs / CIDRs that bypass the proxy (comma separated)

key.name: routing-block-domains
key.summary: Domains that are blocked (comma separated suffixes)

key.name: routing-direct-apps
key.summary: Process names that bypass the proxy (comma separated)

key.name: ping-stale-minutes
key.summary: Latency results older than this are shown as stale and ignored by Best

key.name: latest-version
key.summary: Latest release tag seen on GitHub (empty = never checked)

key.name: last-version-check
key.summary: Unix time of the last successful version check

key.name: update-request
key.summary: Written by the settings window to ask the extension to update (subId|timestamp or all|timestamp)

key.name: expanded-subs
key.summary: Subscription groups that are expanded in the panel

key.name: auto-reconnect
key.description: Reconnect when the core dies, the tunnel stops answering or the network changes

key.name: auto-connect-best
key.description: With auto-connect on: measure the servers at login and connect to the fastest one instead of the last used

key.name: tls-fragment
key.description: Splits the ClientHello into several records to get past simple DPI filtering

key.name: core-log-verbose
key.description: Log every connection the core makes (destination domains included) into client.log. Off by default: it is your browsing history

key.name: dns-bootstrap
key.summary: Plain DNS server used before the tunnel is up (IP address)

key.name: dns-remote
key.summary: DNS server reached through the tunnel (IP address)

key.name: sub-user-agent
key.summary: User-Agent sent when downloading subscriptions (empty = Qurp default)
